text: Stemshure may be sprayed at up to 3 litres per hectare. A higher rate needs the agronomist to sign off.
Spraying stops when the wind is above 15 km/h. The crew waits and rebooks the job.
A booked job can be moved up to 48 hours before the crew arrives. After that the grower pays a fee.
Cropguard is sold in 20 litre drums. One drum treats about 10 hectares.
